summary: Patched hardware RT console variable readback to treat None and 0/falsy handles as missing before invoking SPEAR value getters, and adjusted ray-traced spotlight shadow probing to prefer explicit enabled enum/string/integer candidates before bool fallback. Added regression coverage for null CVar handles and enum-valued ray-traced shadow method/property paths.
work_completed: Updated examples/flashlight/run.py so try_read_console_variable_int exits on falsy console variable handles before getter calls.
Updated examples/flashlight/flashlight_profiles.py to include SetCastRaytracedShadows and CastRaytracedShadows spellings and to try explicit enabled values before bool True.
Added tests for zero console-variable handles returning missing/unsupported readback without getter calls or crashes.
Added tests for enum-shaped ray-traced shadow setters and properties to ensure applied intent is Enabled rather than UseProjectSetting.
